title: Wire FCA convention persistence into production path
description:
FCA conventions are computed fresh in-memory on each sutra_review call and discarded. The DB infrastructure exists (conventions table, upsert_convention, all_conventions, delete_stale_conventions) but is never wired up.

Wire rebuild results into db.upsert_convention(). Call db.delete_stale_conventions() with current ID set. Optionally move FCA rebuild into post_parse_sequence for incremental updates.

This unblocks PRD story 13 (temporal convention tracking: first_seen, last_seen).

acceptance_criteria.text: Conventions persisted to SQLite after FCA rebuild
conventions table has populated first_seen/last_seen columns
Review results identical before and after (persistence is additive)

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (c480f64..390462c):

Verdict: needs-attention

[medium] FCA persistence and pruning failures silently swallowed (src/tools/review.rs:198-208). Every convention upsert and stale-prune call discards its Result. If SQLite rejects a write, review still returns as if persistence succeeded — no degraded flag or log. Pruning still runs after failed upserts, risking partial convention state or deletion of older rows without recording new set.

Recommendation: Run convention upserts and stale pruning as one transaction, only prune after all upserts succeed. At minimum, log and surface persistence failure in the review response.
